literal: In the waking state, our (beloved) abandoned (us), they say; in dream, do they not see (him), the people of this town?
translation: The people of this town say that my beloved has abandoned me, judging only by the waking state. Do they not see him coming to me in their own dreams?
modern: விழித்திருக்கும்போது நம் காதலர் நம்மை விட்டுப் பிரிந்துவிட்டார் என்று இவ்வூரார் சொல்கிறார்கள்; அவர்கள் தங்கள் கனவில் அவரைக் காண்பதில்லையோ?
explanation: The heroine is pining for her departed lover, and the townspeople gossip that he has abandoned her. She counters this by stating that he only appears to have left during the waking state (நனவினால்). In her dreams (கனவினால்), he is constantly present with her. She wonders aloud if the townspeople ever experience dreams themselves, as they seem completely ignorant of the nightly reunions she enjoys with her beloved.
